findings.title: An endpoint theorem is tied as exact evidence for a different intermediate inequality

observed.row_statement: For fixed k: for large m, c k^{-29} (m/log(km))^{1-1/k} > floor(m^{1-1/k}/(log_2 m)^2).

tie.note: Proved directly, so no translation from the published bound is used.

findings.interpretation: bansalSinhaLower proves Lvalue k t < R (P k t), eventually at each fixed k. It does not state the displayed comparison between the published lower-bound expression and L. A direct proof bypasses that comparison. This is an evidence-assignment defect, not a detected defect in the unconditional theorem.

display_override.label: Tie disputed: endpoint substituted for intermediate inequality
display_override.checked_route: bypass this node; use lem-2.1.i with the actual theorem

findings.proposed_repair: Remove this exact tie from this row pending a theorem for the numerical comparison; retain the direct proof under lem-2.1.i. Preserve the paper dependency separately from the Lean route.

findings.title: Forrelation lower-bound theorem has an incorrect source locator and kind
findings.interpretation: The proposition BansalSinhaLower is defined in Statement.lean, while the theorem proving it is in ForrelationLower/Main.lean. They need separate links.

display_override.label: Source locator corrected in this advisory; corpus unchanged

findings.proposed_repair: Resolve every declaration by fully qualified name and compare the resolved kind/file/line with the ledger locator. Require an explicit declaration-resolution receipt.

findings.title: A legacy theorem has an unrecorded BansalSinhaLower binder
findings.interpretation: The empty hypotheses array is not a trustworthy statement that this declaration is unconditional. Its explicit source binder is visible. This does not affect theorem_1_1_unconditional.
findings.proposed_repair: Reconcile tie binders against an elaborated type export; retain a source-text fallback labelled unelaborated. Distinguish open assumptions from ordinary quantified variables and proved hypotheses.

findings.title: The fidelity review and parts of the blueprint predate the delivered snapshot
source_locations: repository/README.md:What is checked and what that means

observed.review_says: headline conditional; build/comparator all not_run; root not yet importing lower proof
observed.current_snapshot_says: unconditional headline; some rows compared; root imports Results.Unconditional

findings.interpretation: The older review contains useful semantic checks but cannot supply the current headline or evidence state. It should be displayed as an earlier review with coverage/version information.

display_override.label: Earlier AI review; findings may have been resolved

findings.proposed_repair: Version review findings independently and record resolution links rather than editing the historical review into a current-state dashboard.

findings.title: The graph contains stale fidelity review status

observed.graph_record: fidelity_review status=not_run; tool=Independent statement-fidelity reading not yet run
observed.available_reviews: AI reviews by agents other than the proof author; no human review reported

findings.interpretation: A different AI agent is author-independent in a limited procedural sense, but no human review has occurred. The graph string and the actual review documents should not be silently merged.

display_override.label: AI semantic reviews available; human review not reported

findings.proposed_repair: Add review kind, author/prover relationship, reviewed pin, coverage, findings, and human_review_status fields.

findings.title: Negative-control harness success is encoded as passed and could be mistaken for proof acceptance

observed.trace_runner_rule: code == 1 and expected diagnostic in log and Build completed in log; status passed means rejected_as_expected

findings.interpretation: The graph loses the distinction between test success and Comparator acceptance. The wrong solutions are reported as rejected, while the negative-control test passed.
findings.proposed_repair: Store harness_status, comparator_exit_code, comparator_verdict, expected_diagnostic, observed_diagnostic and log hash independently; link the original receipt.

findings.title: Raw build and Comparator receipts are not members of this packet
findings.interpretation: The packet reports passes and includes source/configuration and summarized run records. It does not provide raw logs/export hashes or the original receipt files needed to independently authenticate or reproduce the reported run. Snapshot identity and run identity are separate.

display_override.label: Reported local pass; original receipt absent from this packet

findings.proposed_repair: Add full receipt records and logs, bind source/export/dependency hashes to each run, and record source-equivalence across metadata-only commits if used.

findings.title: Row-level exactness and reachability can come from different declarations
findings.interpretation: An exact row and reached row must not be combined into a claim that an exact formalization of the paper step is on the headline route. Status is a relation among a particular statement, declaration and run.

display_override.default_badge: Exact statement available; headline uses a related declaration

findings.proposed_repair: Keep selected_evidence_tie explicit; permit multiple views and display alternative routes without inheriting statuses across them.

findings.title: The equation (19) stronger label applies to the bound, not to its displayed identity

observed.note: The row identity with E Z/m has no counterpart because Z is never defined

findings.interpretation: The inequality is stronger. The whole displayed equality-and-bound has clause-level coverage differences. A single green stronger badge would hide them.

display_override.label: Stronger inequality; identity with Z is not formalized here

findings.proposed_repair: Split or annotate clauses while preserving the existing row identity; do not treat a stronger inequality as proof of an additional equality.

findings.title: Some statements have existing source evidence but no reviewed tie
findings.interpretation: No reviewed tie is not evidence of mathematical falsehood or of absent Lean code. These candidate links should stay candidate links until the relation is reviewed.
findings.proposed_repair: Add reviewed mappings at the same snapshot with relation/route notes and matching run evidence; do not manufacture a proof gap by ignoring the source, or a checked badge by trusting a tag.

findings.title: The corpus lacks complete exact paper quotations and elaborated Lean theorem types

observed.has: normalized ledger text, coarse source_line, declaration/file/line, hashes of ledger text
observed.lacks: paper quote span/PDF coordinates; exact full elaborated theorem type; definition closure hash; linked run id per tie

findings.interpretation: The requested side-by-side fidelity view cannot be generated from the corpus JSON alone. Source text can be shown now with a label; elaborated type and source-pinned provenance require new producer fields.
findings.proposed_repair: Implement the additions in data_contract.md and prevent rendering unresolved links as verified.

checks.comparison_method: textual normalization only; no elaboration or Comparator run
